# openmetadata_test_suite (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata logical test suite. A logical suite groups test cases and carries no connection or entity reference, so it is created through the generic test suite endpoint rather than the basic suite endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_test_suite" "quality_gate" {
  name         = "quality_gate"
  display_name = "Data Quality Gate"
  description  = "Logical test suite grouping the data quality checks promoted to production."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Test suite name. Changing it replaces the suite, because the name is also its fully qualified name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the test suite.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `basic` (Boolean) Whether the server classified this as a basic entity test suite.
- `executable` (Boolean) Whether the test suite tests an executable entity such as a pipeline.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a logical test suite this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_test_suite.quality_gate 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a logical test suite is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_test_suite.quality_gate quality_gate
```
